acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

path.description:
Path in blob storage relative to dataset-storage baseUrl.
Usually has form of "dataset.guid/partition.id", where dataset-guid - is id of dataset, under which it was uploaded originally.

filename.description:
Partition filename.
Doesn't have to be unique. Often versions of the same file are uploaded multiple times.

status.description: Status of the partition. @see c3.vad.model.datasets.PartitionStatus for possible values.

title:
Type representing metadata about dataset partitions stored in blob storage.
ExMachina dataset consists of one or more partitions.
Partition is readonly and immutable.
name: ExMachinaDatasetPartitionMetadata
